name: design-skill-evals
job: Design a same-prompt paired skill eval that can disprove lift and veto on harm.

inScope: Freezing the claim, digest, job, artifact, and predeclared harm
Writing real user prompts that do not name the skill or leak SKILL.md
Same-prompt with-skill vs baseline comparison under one harness
Deterministic artifact oracles and a harm that can fail a happy path
outOfScope: House coverage KPIs, required receipts, or four-way daily gates
Using qualification as a use gate

inputs: The exact skill digest (name, description, body, references, scripts)
The job, artifact, nearest neighbours, and harms to falsify
One harness and environment for the run
outputs: evals/suite.json with a same-prompt agent pair
Deterministic oracles plus at least one harm veto
Optional qualification.json when a reproducible run is applied

permissions: write access to the package evals/ and qualification record

failureSemantics: A lift claim is invalid without a same-prompt pair, a live packageDigest bind, and a clean harm scan. Failures edit the skill, not the threshold. Any later loaded-byte change invalidates the record.

outcome.observable: An independent run produces BENCHMARK.md and a report whose with-skill vs baseline comparison and harm scan can be recomputed from the recorded artifacts.
